Meet New York Bagelry

Authentic NY kettle-boiled bagels for over 30 years

New York Bagelry is a bagel shop and bakery on Penn Avenue in West Lawn, Reading, PA. Its own listing says it has been bringing authentic NY kettle-boiled bagels to Berks County for over 30 years.

The bagel case runs Rainbow, Cinnamon Crunch, French Toast, Everything, Chocolate Chip, and Jalapeño Cheddar. For breakfast and lunch there are sandwiches like the BLT, the Turkey Club, and Taylor Ham, plus crumb cake.
